introduction: Mississippi Center for Legal Services provides civil legal aid to eligible low-income residents in central and southern Mississippi.
description: Mississippi Center for Legal Services provides civil legal aid to eligible low-income residents in central and southern Mississippi.

sections.who: The organization screens income, county, issue and case capacity. Confirm the correct office through an independent legal-aid directory.
sections.get: Assistance may include advice or representation for accepted civil cases. Intake alone does not create a lawyer-client relationship.
sections.docs:
• County and household information.
  • Court papers, notices and dates.
  • Income details requested during screening.
sections.apply:
1. Confirm contact details

    Use LSC’s legal-aid locator to identify the serving office.

  2. Request intake

    Explain your civil issue and any deadline. Ask which application route is currently in use.

  3. Provide records as directed

    Confirm the intake channel with the office before sending sensitive documents.
sections.after: Keep court deadlines unless a lawyer advises otherwise.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using MCLS service overview; LSC legal-aid locator. Some current details still need confirmation; contact the program before relying on them.
